literal: Birth-called ignorance to depart, liberation-called Ultimate Reality perceiving is wisdom.
translation: True wisdom is to perceive the Ultimate Reality, which is called liberation, so that the ignorance called birth may depart.
modern: பிறப்பு என்று சொல்லப்படும் அறியாமை நீங்குவதற்காக, வீடுபேறு என்று சொல்லப்படும் செம்பொருளைக் காண்பதே உண்மையான அறிவாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines true wisdom as the direct perception of the Ultimate Reality (செம்பொருள்). The poet equates the cycle of birth (பிறப்பு) with ignorance (பேதைமை), suggesting that physical existence is a state of delusion. To remove this ignorance, one must perceive the supreme truth, which is identified with liberation or excellence (சிறப்பு). Therefore, true knowledge is not academic learning, but the spiritual insight that dissolves delusion and ends the cycle of rebirth.
